68:   const importers = mapValues((importer) => {
69:     const newImporter = filterImporter(importer, opts.include)
70:     if (newImporter.optionalDependencies != null) {
71:       newImporter.optionalDependencies = pickBy((ref, depName) => {
72:         const depPath = dp.refToRelative(ref, depName)
73:         return !depPath || packages[depPath] != null
74:       }, newImporter.optionalDependencies)
75:     }
76:     return newImporter
77:   }, lockfile.importers)
78: 
79:   return {
80:     lockfile: {
81:       ...lockfile,
82:       importers,
83:       packages,
84:     },
85:     selectedImporterIds: Array.from(importerIdSet),
86:   }
87: }
88: 
89: function pickPkgsWithAllDeps (
90:   lockfile: Lockfile,
91:   depPaths: string[],
92:   importerIdSet: Set<string>,
93:   opts: {
94:     currentEngine: {
95:       nodeVersion?: string
96:       pnpmVersion: string
97:     }
98:     engineStrict: boolean
99:     failOnMissingDependencies: boolean
100:     include: { [dependenciesField in DependenciesField]: boolean }
101:     includeIncompatiblePackages: boolean
102:     lockfileDir: string
103:     skipped: Set<string>
104:     supportedArchitectures?: SupportedArchitectures
105:   }
106: ) {
107:   const pickedPackages = {} as PackageSnapshots
108:   pkgAllDeps({ lockfile, pickedPackages, importerIdSet }, depPaths, true, opts)
109:   return pickedPackages
110: }
111: 
112: function pkgAllDeps (
113:   ctx: {
114:     lockfile: Lockfile
115:     pickedPackages: PackageSnapshots
116:     importerIdSet: Set<string>
117:   },
118:   depPaths: string[],
119:   parentIsInstallable: boolean,
120:   opts: {
121:     currentEngine: {
122:       nodeVersion?: string
123:       pnpmVersion: string
124:     }
125:     engineStrict: boolean
126:     failOnMissingDependencies: boolean
127:     include: { [dependenciesField in DependenciesField]: boolean }
128:     includeIncompatiblePackages: boolean
129:     lockfileDir: string
130:     skipped: Set<string>
131:     supportedArchitectures?: SupportedArchitectures
132:   }
133: ) {
134:   for (const depPath of depPaths) {
135:     if (ctx.pickedPackages[depPath]) continue
136:     const pkgSnapshot = ctx.lockfile.packages![depPath]
137:     if (!pkgSnapshot && !depPath.startsWith('link:')) {
138:       if (opts.failOnMissingDependencies) {
139:         throw new LockfileMissingDependencyError(depPath)
140:       }
141:       lockfileLogger.debug(`No entry for "${depPath}" in ${WANTED_LOCKFILE}`)
142:       continue
143:     }
144:     let installable!: boolean
145:     if (!parentIsInstallable) {
146:       installable = false
147:       if (!ctx.pickedPackages[depPath] && pkgSnapshot.optional === true) {
148:         opts.skipped.add(depPath)
149:       }
150:     } else {
151:       const pkg = {
152:         ...nameVerFromPkgSnapshot(depPath, pkgSnapshot),
153:         cpu: pkgSnapshot.cpu,
154:         engines: pkgSnapshot.engines,
155:         os: pkgSnapshot.os,
156:         libc: pkgSnapshot.libc,
157:       }
158:       // TODO: depPath is not the package ID. Should be fixed
159:       installable =
160:         opts.includeIncompatiblePackages ||
161:         packageIsInstallable(pkgSnapshot.id ?? depPath, pkg, {
162:           engineStrict: opts.engineStrict,
163:           lockfileDir: opts.lockfileDir,
164:           nodeVersion: opts.currentEngine.nodeVersion,
165:           optional: pkgSnapshot.optional === true,
166:           pnpmVersion: opts.currentEngine.pnpmVersion,
167:           supportedArchitectures: opts.supportedArchitectures,
168:         }) !== false
169:       if (!installable) {
170:         if (!ctx.pickedPackages[depPath] && pkgSnapshot.optional === true) {
171:           opts.skipped.add(depPath)
172:         }
173:       } else {
174:         opts.skipped.delete(depPath)
175:       }
176:     }
177:     ctx.pickedPackages[depPath] = pkgSnapshot
178:     const { depPaths: nextRelDepPaths, importerIds: additionalImporterIds } = parseDepRefs(Object.entries({
179:       ...pkgSnapshot.dependencies,
180:       ...(opts.include.optionalDependencies
181:         ? pkgSnapshot.optionalDependencies
182:         : {}),
183:     }), ctx.lockfile)
184:     additionalImporterIds.forEach((importerId) => ctx.importerIdSet.add(importerId))
185:     nextRelDepPaths.push(
186:       ...toImporterDepPaths(ctx.lockfile, additionalImporterIds, {
187:         include: opts.include,
188:         importerIdSet: ctx.importerIdSet,
189:       })
190:     )
191:     pkgAllDeps(ctx, nextRelDepPaths, installable, opts)
192:   }
193: }
194: 
195: function toImporterDepPaths (
196:   lockfile: Lockfile,
197:   importerIds: string[],
198:   opts: {
199:     include: { [dependenciesField in DependenciesField]: boolean }
200:     importerIdSet: Set<string>
201:   }
202: ): string[] {
203:   const importerDeps = importerIds
204:     .map(importerId => lockfile.importers[importerId])
205:     .map(importer => ({
206:       ...(opts.include.dependencies ? importer.dependencies : {}),
207:       ...(opts.include.devDependencies ? importer.devDependencies : {}),
208:       ...(opts.include.optionalDependencies
209:         ? importer.optionalDependencies
210:         : {}),
211:     }))
212:     .map(Object.entries)
213: 
214:   const { depPaths, importerIds: nextImporterIds } = parseDepRefs(unnest(importerDeps), lockfile)
215: 
216:   if (!nextImporterIds.length) {
217:     return depPaths
218:   }
219:   nextImporterIds.forEach((importerId) => {
220:     opts.importerIdSet.add(importerId)
221:   })
222:   return [
223:     ...depPaths,
224:     ...toImporterDepPaths(lockfile, nextImporterIds, opts),
225:   ]
226: }
227: 
228: function parseDepRefs (refsByPkgNames: Array<[string, string]>, lockfile: Lockfile) {
229:   return refsByPkgNames
230:     .reduce((acc, [pkgName, ref]) => {
231:       if (ref.startsWith('link:')) {
232:         const importerId = ref.substring(5)
233:         if (lockfile.importers[importerId]) {
234:           acc.importerIds.push(importerId)
235:         }
236:         return acc
237:       }
238:       const depPath = dp.refToRelative(ref, pkgName)
239:       if (depPath == null) return acc
240:       acc.depPaths.push(depPath)
241:       return acc
242:     }, { depPaths: [] as string[], importerIds: [] as string[] })
243: }

# pnpm v9.0.0 Lockfile v6 Impact Report

## Overview

Two core changes for v9.0.0 affect the lockfile format:

1. **Lockfile version bump to v6** — `@pnpm/constants` promotes `LOCKFILE_VERSION_V6 = '6.0'` to the new default; the old `LOCKFILE_VERSION = 5.4` is retired.
2. **Registry URL removal from package IDs** — `@pnpm/dependency-path` stops embedding the registry URL in dep paths (e.g., `/registry.npmjs.org/foo/1.0.0` → `/foo/1.0.0`).

---

## 1. Current Constants (`packages/constants/src/index.ts`)

```ts
export const LOCKFILE_VERSION    = 5.4    // retired in v9
export const LOCKFILE_VERSION_V6 = '6.0'  // becomes the sole default in v9
```

---

## 2. Packages Directly Depending on `@pnpm/constants` (via `workspace:*`)

| Package | Relevant Constants Used | Impact |
|---------|------------------------|--------|
| `lockfile/lockfile-file` | `LOCKFILE_VERSION`, `WANTED_LOCKFILE` | **Major** — fallback in `createLockfileObject()` uses `LOCKFILE_VERSION` |
